subject: sdk: add the bounded Gateway JSON query client
scope: JSON-query SDK only. Delivery archive of oo-sdk, contracts/sdk/json-query, and the lock graph that commit adds. Full SP09-W01, AT-API-01, OpenAPI, exports, discover, describe, resolve, search, freshness, from_sandbox_env, query cancellation, CLI, real Gateway, real PostgreSQL, and amd64 remain pending.
head: 8efeb230afc6734a2e50eaca3f09fd78300a9c7d

stamp.subject: sdk: record the JSON query delivery commit

acceptance_tree: git archive of the delivery commit. The moving workspace was not used. The probe tree adds only crates/oo-sdk/tests/a084_probe.rs.

probe_1.note: SSL_CERT_DIR=/certs and a second Content-Length on the declared-length case. Same bytes as probe/probe-report.json.

tools_1_path.cause: bash -lc dropped /usr/local/cargo/bin; cargo-audit and cargo-deny not found

findings.expected: Gateway message() and hint() omit the caller bearer at every accepted length. Debug and Display already omit it. docs/10-security.md:108 requires credential-pattern redaction of errors. The contract says accessors return text only after the token is stripped.
findings.actual: Replacement runs only when token.len() >= 8. Probe 2 short_token_reflected (len 6) and token_len_7: message_has_token true, hint_has_token true, display_has_token false, result gateway. token_len_8 passed.
findings.repair: Strip the raw token and the Bearer prefix for every token BearerToken::new accepts. Keep Debug and Display free of the value.

findings.expected: message() and hint() omit the request SQL. The contract lists SQL among the secrets stripped before the accessors return.
findings.actual: Replacement runs only when sql.len() >= 24. Probe 2 short_sql_reflected: sql_len 14, message_has_sql true, display_has_sql false, hint_has_sql false, result gateway. The long-SQL case passed.
findings.repair: Strip the request SQL at every length the client accepted.

findings.expected: A gateway message that carries the bearer in percent-encoded form does not return that form from message() or hint().
findings.actual: Probe 2 percent_encoded_token, token_len 8: message_has_token false, message_has_percent_form true for Abcd%45%4612. scrub_text searches the raw token and does not decode percent-encoding.
findings.repair: Strip percent-encoded forms of the token as well as the raw token.

findings.expected: A larger decimal Retry-After is not shortened and is not retried. Missing, duplicated, and non-decimal values use 200 ms, 400 ms, then 800 ms. An 8-digit all-digit value is parsed.
findings.actual: text.len() > 8 returns None, and None takes the backoff path. Probe 2 retry_after_9_digits_not_retried: hits 2, elapsed_ms 238, result ok. retry_after_8_digits_not_shortened and retry_after_3s_not_shortened each stopped at hits 1, result gateway. Fractional 1.5 and an HTTP-date used backoff, which matches the non-decimal rule.
findings.repair: Parse an all-digit Retry-After beyond 8 digits. If the duration is greater than max_wait, do not retry. Keep the backoff path for missing, duplicated, and non-digit values.

findings.expected: Accessor text does not keep the base URL the client used.
findings.actual: Only scheme://authority is replaced, and only when that origin is at least 8 characters. Probe 2 base_url_path_remainder: origin_left false, path_left true, result gateway.
findings.repair: Replace the full base URL, including the path, or omit the URL from accessor text.

findings.expected: The Authorization HeaderValue is marked sensitive so reqwest debug formatting treats it as secret.
findings.actual: The snapshot sources contain no HeaderValue::set_sensitive call. Debug and Display of BearerToken are BearerToken([redacted]). Probe 2 debug_redacts_token: token_debug is that string and client debug does not contain the token. This review did not capture an SDK log line that printed the header. The reproduced leak is SDK-SCRUB-SHORT-TOKEN.
findings.repair: Call set_sensitive(true) on the authorization value.

findings.function: cargo deny --locked check on the delivery config
findings.expected: The locked graph that ci/deny.toml checks satisfies the existing allow list. CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is not on that list. The config has no targets key, so the check is the locked target-all graph. No allow entry is added.
findings.actual: cargo-deny 0.20.2 exit 4. licenses.errors 1. Diagnostic code rejected, span CDLA-Permissive-2.0, message failed to satisfy license requirements, parents rustls-platform-verifier 0.7.0 from oo-sdk 0.1.0 and reqwest 0.13.5. The Linux arm64 edges tree does not select webpki-root-certs 1.0.9. tree-all.txt does. The crate publishes license CDLA-Permissive-2.0 and ships LICENSE. The linux selection does not close this gate.
findings.repair: Remove webpki-root-certs 1.0.9 from the graph this deny config checks. Leave ci/deny.toml unchanged. Do not add a CDLA allow.

findings.function: license admission versus cargo-deny OR semantics
findings.expected: supply-chain/policy.md admits MIT OR Apache-2.0 only with dual_license_choice and LICENSE evidence covering every declared license. LGPL needs weak_copyleft_review. The or-later form fails closed. A locator basename is LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING, or NOTICE. cargo-deny accepting one allowed alternative is not policy admission. ci/deny.toml stays as it is.
findings.actual: Both versions publish MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later, rust-version 1.68. The registry body has AUTHORS and README.md. The license-file walk found AUTHORS and no LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING, or NOTICE. r-efi 6.0.0 is on the target-all graph and absent from the Linux arm64 edges tree. cargo-deny reported a duplicate-version warning and no license error for r-efi.
findings.repair: Record one admissible license, point at LICENSE evidence for every declared license, and include weak_copyleft_review if LGPL remains in force. Otherwise remove the crate from the locked graph. Do not weaken deny or the policy.

findings.function: license admission versus cargo-deny OR semantics
findings.expected: A three-way OR needs dual_license_choice and LICENSE evidence for every declared license. CC0-1.0 is outside the ci/deny.toml allow list. Deny accepting MIT-0 or Apache-2.0 is not a policy record. ci/deny.toml stays as it is.
findings.actual: Published license CC0-1.0 OR MIT-0 OR Apache-2.0. No rust-version field. Selected on linux/arm64 under aws-lc-sys build-dependencies (tree-linux-edges.txt:301). cargo-deny emitted no dunce license error.
findings.repair: Add a policy record that chooses an allowed license and covers every declared license with a real locator, or remove the crate from the locked graph. Do not add CC0-1.0 to the deny allow list in this review.

observations.actual: bounded_option (crates/oo-core/src/api.rs:833-845) maps JSON null to None. Probe 2 door_null_max_rows: door_rejected false, max_rows_is_none true, client_not_called true. wire.rs:36-37 says the frozen schema rejects null. The encoder still omits nulls, and 0 and 2001 fail in encode_request before connect.
observations.reason: The comment overstates the door. The client did not open a socket. This is not a request_changes driver.

observations.actual: Probe 2 loopback_127_255_255_255: hits 0, result transport.connect. The endpoint treats 127.0.0.0/8 as loopback, so the address is not NotLoopback.
observations.reason: The connect failure is this container's TCP result. It does not show the SDK rejecting a loopback address.

observations.actual: Run 1 platform_roots_reject_private_ca completed an HTTP hit because SSL_CERT_DIR=/certs contained CA A. Run 1 declared_length_over_cap was transport.incomplete because the probe added a second Content-Length. Run 2: platform http_hits 0 result transport.connect; declared length result protocol.declared_too_large hits 1.
observations.reason: Those two run-1 rows are probe setup. The six product failures are stable on both runs.

observations.actual: slow_headers_client_timeout: transport.timeout, display says the client stopped, display_contains_cancel false, backend_cancel pending_real_gateway_pg. future_drop_not_backend_cancel: server_read_after_abort eof, same pending label.
observations.reason: A client timeout or a dropped future is pending real Gateway and PostgreSQL cancellation.

observations.actual: 30 added crates publish no rust-version. 101 publish one. None of those 101 are above 1.94.0. The smoke compiled the Linux arm64 graph with rustc 1.94.0.
observations.reason: A missing rust-version field is not proof above the floor and not proof below the floor.

observations.actual: cargo-audit 0.22.2 exit 0, vulnerabilities.found false, count 0, advisory-count 1279, dependency-count 267. Yanked list from the registry compare is empty.
observations.reason: A zero RustSec result is one database. It does not admit the supply chain.

observations.actual: aws-lc-sys 0.45.0 publishes ISC AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC) AND Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-3-Clause AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT) AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT-0). aws-lc-rs 1.18.1 publishes ISC AND (Apache-2.0 OR ISC). LICENSE and aws-lc/LICENSE are in the fetched body. The smoke target directory aws-lc-sys-a105f2b1660f99a0 has 371 objects and libaws_lc_0_45_0_crypto.a. Build output says Building with: CC, cmake count 0, static link of aws_lc_0_45_0_crypto, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.
observations.reason: Each SPDX token is on the deny allow list, so deny did not error. An AND keeps every obligation. This review did not find a conjunction exception document. The bodies and the native archive are real.

observations.actual: a073 REPORT.md describes an earlier clippy failure on dead_code and clippy::manual_is_multiple_of and says the raw log was not archived. The a073 tree has host/cargo-clippy-2.log EXIT:0 and no cargo-clippy-1.log. host/cargo-test-1.log and host/cargo-test-2.log end EXIT:101. host/cargo-test-3.log ends EXIT:0. This review's clippy on the delivery archive exited 0.
observations.reason: The missing failure log is not reconstructed. The preserved test exits stay 101 and 0 as archived.

observations.actual: Linux arm64 selects openssl-probe 0.2.1 and rustls-native-certs 0.8.4 through rustls-platform-verifier. It does not select sqlx. Probe 2 OnlyPem with CA A succeeded while SSL_CERT_FILE was CA B (http_hits 1). OnlyPem rejected the other root, the wrong hostname, and the expired certificate (http_hits 0). Platform roots with SSL_CERT_DIR unset rejected the private CA (http_hits 0, transport.connect).
observations.reason: SDK Gateway trust and a private-CA-only Postgres source graph are different graphs. reqwest's Linux platform verifier pulling native certificate crates is not SQLx root contamination.

controls_probe_2: handwritten canonical bodies matched on the socket, including the mount path /mount/v1/query
duplicate keys, unknown fields, high precision, and NUL SQL rejected before a client call
typed 0, 2001, and 120001 rejected with zero accepts
eighteen hostile base URLs rejected with zero accepts: dot segments, already-/v1/query, percent-encoding, userinfo, query, fragment, backslash, mapped IPv4, non-loopback, production http, ftp
no gzip advertisement; gzip body is protocol.rejected
row width, row count, row budget, duplicate response key, content-type, and status/envelope coherence
duplicate Content-Length and Content-Length plus chunked are conflicting framing; declared over-cap is protocol.declared_too_large
retry only complete retryable 429 RATE_LIMITED or 503 OVERLOADED, at most 3 extra attempts, RetryPolicy::none disables, 401 and partial and INTERNAL and AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE and TIMEOUT are single-shot
8-digit and 3-second Retry-After are not retried; 1-second Retry-After waits about 1 second
OnlyPem root exclusivity and hostname and expiry checks; platform roots reject the private CA when SSL_CERT_DIR is unset
